translation_notes: the two RDF ops are URIRef(<runtime string>) with no lexical structure at all; they become formatted-IRI islands f<{val}> / f<{self.base}> and the `from rdflib import URIRef` import is dropped

finding: the notation brings nothing here -- f<{x}> is exactly URIRef(x) only as long as no @base is in scope, since firi() resolves a relative IRI against the declared base. A mechanical URIRef(x) -> f<{x}> rule is therefore unsafe inside a block that declares @base; here none is declared, so the rewrite is exact
the rest of the region (urljoin corner cases, URI-scheme warning) is string plumbing that no island can touch -- the RDF layer is only reached at the very last step
